scope: Exposed contemporary source-bounded prioritization development; no clinical or therapeutic accuracy claim
selection_order: Original fixed ten-case build order, then Category enumeration order; retain every screening disposition; no outcome/reference-based replacements

candidate_world.policy: Complete admitted case world reconstructed before explicit task-category projection; shared whole-record bounded retrieval with worst-role control reservation

role_policy.amendment: Copy policy unchanged except adding selection_cap:1; preserve reviewer/synthesis subset constraint

reference_policy.question: Which single offered original source annotation is most directly applicable to the stated target, indication, intended action and modality, preserving uncertainty? Abstain if none is sufficiently applicable; do not infer intervention benefit.
reference_policy.inputs: Only exact shared scientific candidate packets and hypothesis; no arm outputs, previous Q1 references, other reviewer answers, internet enrichment or labels
reference_policy.adjudication: Third source-grounded reconciliation only after both reviews sealed; preserve disagreement and ties
reference_policy.freeze: Task/source membership before reviews; both reviews and adjudication sealed before any native model dispatch
reference_policy.limitations: AI-source-adjudicated development references; shared biases, no independent clinical truth or expert-validation claim

evaluation.unit: Paired task and case descriptive results; no significance/superiority/population claims
evaluation.all_tied: Retain non-discriminative task; do not resample or force ranking
evaluation.prediction_seal: Seal and source-verify all outputs before joining reference answers

failure_policy: Reserve durable outputs before dispatch; preserve partial attempts/accounting and owned-server cleanup. No automatic repeat or selective replacement. Fewer eligible tasks are reported as such.
